name: Planet buy-order best-effort matching lifecycle
description: JSON protocol acceptance for unreserved placement, matching-time credit and capacity checks, partial fill, and durable cancellation.

tests.name: Setup: Admin
Setup: Planet market buyer
Isolate ORE market fixture from stale disposable orders

data.sql: UPDATE commodity_orders SET status = 'cancelled', cancellation_reason = 'isolated market lifecycle fixture' WHERE commodity_id = (SELECT commodities_id FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE') AND status = 'open';

tests.name: Read current planet buy-order expiry configuration
Set minimum valid buy-order expiry
Reject buy-order expiry below configured range
Reject buy-order expiry above configured range
Set 24-hour expiry for matching scenario
Grant Genesis device to create the test planet

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET genesis = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'planet_market_buyer_v3');

tests.name: Create buyer-owned planet
Choose a real port for the sell-side fixture

data.sql: SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE is_active=TRUE ORDER BY port_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Cancel unrelated market orders at the isolated seller port

data.sql: UPDATE commodity_orders SET status = 'cancelled', cancellation_reason = 'isolated planet market lifecycle fixture' WHERE location_type = 'port' AND location_id = @{market_seller_port_id} AND status = 'open';

tests.name: Set buyer balance to zero before placing the unreserved order

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance = 0 WHERE owner_type = 'player' AND owner_id = @{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE;

tests.name: Fill planet ORE storage before placing the unreserved order

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT 'planet', @{market_planet_id}, 'ORE', max_capacity FROM planet_goods WHERE planet_id = @{market_planet_id} AND commodity = 'ORE' ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

tests.name: Place best-effort order without credits or free storage
Verify order expiry is persisted using configured lifetime

data.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (expires_at - ts))::integer FROM commodity_orders WHERE commodity_orders_id = @{market_buy_order_id};

tests.name: Restore prior buy-order expiry configuration

data.note: Restore prior setting after acceptance test

tests.name: Provide funds and storage only after order placement

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance = 250 WHERE owner_type = 'player' AND owner_id = @{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE;

tests.name: Free the destination planet storage before matching

data.sql: UPDATE entity_stock SET quantity = 0 WHERE entity_type = 'planet' AND entity_id = @{market_planet_id} AND commodity_code = 'ORE';

tests.name: Isolate the ORE order book around the one test buy order

data.sql: UPDATE commodity_orders SET status='cancelled', cancellation_reason='isolated planet market lifecycle fixture' WHERE commodity_id=(SELECT commodities_id FROM commodities WHERE code='ORE') AND status='open' AND commodity_orders_id<>@{market_buy_order_id};

tests.name: Seed ten units of seller stock and its account

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity) VALUES ('port', @{market_seller_port_id}, 'ORE', 10) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 10;

tests.name: Ensure seller settlement account starts at zero

data.sql: INSERT INTO bank_accounts (owner_type, owner_id, currency, balance, is_active) VALUES ('port', @{market_seller_port_id}, 'CRD', 0, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (owner_type, owner_id, currency) DO UPDATE SET balance = 0, is_active = TRUE;

tests.name: Create an eligible sell order

data.sql: INSERT INTO commodity_orders (actor_type, actor_id, location_type, location_id, commodity_id, side, quantity, filled_quantity, price, status, ts, expires_at, cancellation_reason) SELECT 'port', @{market_seller_port_id}, 'port', @{market_seller_port_id}, commodities_id, 'sell', 10, 0, 100, 'open', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE' RETURNING commodity_orders_id;

tests.name: Enable deterministic scheduler only in the disposable database

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

tests.name: Save Exchange ORE before isolating the test order book

data.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='exchange' AND entity_id=1 AND commodity_code='ORE'),0);

tests.name: Disable ring-fenced Exchange ORE while asserting the port seller

data.sql: UPDATE entity_stock SET quantity=0 WHERE entity_type='exchange' AND entity_id=1 AND commodity_code='ORE';

tests.name: Choose synthetic settlement time

data.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::bigint+300;

tests.name: Disable unrelated cron handlers and make market settlement due

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='daily_market_settlement'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='daily_market_settlement' THEN to_timestamp(@{market_settlement_at}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Run the actual market settlement handler at synthetic time
Verify two-unit partial fill and unexecutable remainder cancellation

data.sql: SELECT status, filled_quantity, quantity - filled_quantity, cancellation_reason FROM commodity_orders WHERE commodity_orders_id = @{market_buy_order_id};

tests.name: Verify authoritative stock, credits, and trade settlement

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{market_planet_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'), (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE), (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='port' AND entity_id=@{market_seller_port_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'), (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='port' AND owner_id=@{market_seller_port_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE), (SELECT quantity FROM commodity_trades WHERE buyer_actor_type='player' AND buyer_actor_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND buyer_location_type='planet' AND buyer_location_id=@{market_planet_id} AND seller_location_type='port' AND seller_location_id=@{market_seller_port_id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1);

tests.name: Rearm only the market matcher for a deterministic idempotency retry

data.sql: SELECT @{market_settlement_at}+30;

tests.name: Rearm only settlement at the retry time

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='daily_market_settlement'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='daily_market_settlement' THEN to_timestamp(@{market_settlement_retry_at}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Retry the real market handler without new eligible orders
Verify scheduler retry cannot duplicate the partial settlement

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT status='cancelled' AND filled_quantity=2 AND cancellation_reason='insufficient_credits' FROM commodity_orders WHERE commodity_orders_id=@{market_buy_order_id})::int,(SELECT quantity=2 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{market_planet_id} AND commodity_code='ORE')::int,(SELECT balance=50 FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM commodity_trades WHERE buyer_actor_type='player' AND buyer_actor_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND buyer_location_type='planet' AND buyer_location_id=@{market_planet_id} AND seller_location_type='port' AND seller_location_id=@{market_seller_port_id})::int;

tests.name: Reset funds and inventory for concurrent settlement acceptance

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=400 WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Clear planet ORE inventory for concurrent settlement

data.sql: UPDATE entity_stock SET quantity=0 WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{market_planet_id} AND commodity_code='ORE';

tests.name: Set concurrent seller stock and account

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity) VALUES('port',@{market_seller_port_id},'ORE',4) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=4;

tests.name: Reset seller settlement account

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=0 WHERE owner_type='port' AND owner_id=@{market_seller_port_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Clear prior open ORE orders before creating the concurrent match

data.sql: UPDATE commodity_orders SET status='cancelled',cancellation_reason='isolated concurrent settlement fixture' WHERE commodity_id=(SELECT commodities_id FROM commodities WHERE code='ORE') AND status='open';

tests.name: Create concurrent eligible buy order through player workflow
Create concurrent eligible sell order

data.sql: INSERT INTO commodity_orders(actor_type,actor_id,location_type,location_id,commodity_id,side,quantity,filled_quantity,price,status,ts,expires_at,cancellation_reason) SELECT 'port',@{market_seller_port_id},'port',@{market_seller_port_id},commodities_id,'sell',4,0,100,'open',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,NULL,NULL FROM commodities WHERE code='ORE' RETURNING commodity_orders_id;

tests.name: Install a controlled delay inside the real trade settlement transaction

data.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qa_delay_market_settlement() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $qa$ BEGIN IF NEW.quantity=4 AND NEW.buyer_actor_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} THEN PERFORM pg_sleep(8); END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $qa$;

tests.name: Attach controlled delay to settlement record insertion

data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER qa_delay_market_settlement BEFORE INSERT ON commodity_trades FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qa_delay_market_settlement();

tests.name: Enable isolated scheduler and select one future settlement timestamp

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

tests.name: Choose concurrent settlement timestamp

data.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::bigint+600;

tests.name: Choose a second scheduler timestamp for concurrent order-lock revalidation

data.sql: SELECT @{concurrent_settlement_at}+3;

tests.name: Make only daily settlement due for both server instances

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='daily_market_settlement'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='daily_market_settlement' THEN to_timestamp(@{concurrent_settlement_at}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Remove unrelated late-created ORE orders from concurrent fixture

data.sql: UPDATE commodity_orders SET status='cancelled',cancellation_reason='isolated concurrent settlement fixture' WHERE commodity_id=(SELECT commodities_id FROM commodities WHERE code='ORE') AND status='open' AND commodity_orders_id NOT IN (@{concurrent_buy_order_id},@{concurrent_sell_order_id});

tests.name: Overlap two settlement handlers after expiring only the disposable scheduler lock

data.sql: UPDATE locks SET until_ms=0 WHERE lock_name='daily_market_settlement';

tests.name: Verify concurrent settlement commits exactly once with conserved assets

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commodity_trades WHERE buyer_actor_type='player' AND buyer_actor_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND buyer_location_id=@{market_planet_id} AND seller_location_id=@{market_seller_port_id} AND quantity=4), (SELECT status='filled' AND filled_quantity=4 FROM commodity_orders WHERE commodity_orders_id=@{concurrent_buy_order_id})::int, (SELECT status='filled' AND filled_quantity=4 FROM commodity_orders WHERE commodity_orders_id=@{concurrent_sell_order_id})::int, (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{market_planet_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'), (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE), (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='port' AND entity_id=@{market_seller_port_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'), (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='port' AND owner_id=@{market_seller_port_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE);

tests.name: Remove test-only settlement delay trigger and function

data.sql: DROP TRIGGER qa_delay_market_settlement ON commodity_trades;

tests.name: Remove test-only settlement delay function

data.sql: DROP FUNCTION qa_delay_market_settlement();

tests.name: Restore Exchange ORE after isolated settlement acceptance

data.sql: UPDATE entity_stock SET quantity=@{market_exchange_ore_before} WHERE entity_type='exchange' AND entity_id=1 AND commodity_code='ORE';
